configured_by: coordinator (background /nimble:plan dispatch, no live user; explicit no-PR, no-gh, ff-only-merge-to-main instruction from dispatching session)

integration.note: NO GitHub PRs, no gh usage, ever, per explicit instruction. Workers edit the main checkout directly on feature/native-tile-system, one task at a time (no true parallel waves). Coordinator reviews diff, runs typecheck+test:prepush itself with visible output, commits per task.

review.note: Coordinator runs npm run typecheck && npm run test:prepush per task. Never trust a worker's own claim that tests passed -- verify output directly.

placements.label: Foundational tiling engine (react-mosaic single-pane integration, task 4a) landed with the per-pane TileHeaderBar switcher (task 3a, D1R3) -- confirm the react-mosaic version choice (1a) and that the header-bar switcher behaves as expected before building split/stack/compose-reuse on top.

gates.note: Revision 3: D1R3 (per-pane header-bar stacks) was a live user decision made after reviewing the revision-2 chip-row implementation against an interactive mockup and rejecting it, so it is no longer an open question -- but the wave-3 gate (after task 4a, the first task that actually renders the header-bar switcher inside the new mosaic host) stays a pause gate, not skip-on-pass, so a human confirms the live implementation matches the approved design before the remaining 7 tasks build on it.
